incident_spec.summary: Performance degradation when adding TOP 1 to a query with ORDER BY.
symptoms: Query with TOP 1 and ORDER BY performs significantly worse than without TOP 1.
Query plan changes from Hash Match to Nested Loops with Table Spool.
incident_spec.mechanism: Row goal optimization leads to suboptimal plan with Nested Loops and Table Spool.

value.sql: SELECT TOP 1 dc.DOCUMENT_ID, dc.COPIES, dc.REQUESTOR, dc.D_ID, cj.FILE_NUMBER FROM DOCUMENT_QUEUE dc JOIN CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL cj ON dc.DOCUMENT_ID = cj.DOCUMENT_ID WHERE dc.QUEUE_DATE <= GETDATE() AND dc.PRINT_LOCATION = 2 ORDER BY cj.FILE_NUMBER

generation_sql: INSERT INTO DOCUMENT_QUEUE (D_ID, DOCUMENT_ID, COPIES, REQUESTOR, QUEUE_DATE, PRINT_LOCATION) SELECT n, n*10, MOD(n, 5), CONCAT('Requestor_', n), DATEADD(DAY, -MOD(n, 30), GETDATE()), MOD(n, 3) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
